sloka: सिद्धार्थाः खलु ते राम नरा ये त्वां पुरीं गतम् ।जलार्द्रमभिषिक्तं च द्रक्ष्यन्ति वसुधाधिपम् ।। ६.१२२.२० ।।
transliteration: siddhārthāḥ khalu te rāma narā ye tvāṁ purīṁ gatam ।jalārdramabhiṣiktaṁ ca drakṣyanti vasudhādhipam ।। 6.122.20 ।।

translations.english: "On reaching the city and consecrated in the kingdom as ruler of the world, people will see you as an accomplished person."
